title: Traffic - Speed Control
description: Use this service request to inquire about the installation of traffic speed control on a street. It should be used to address excessive speed, pedestrian and bicycle safety, cut-through traffic, crashes and quality of life issues. A study and petition will be required if requesting speed control measures. (Measures could include: road/speed humps, street markings, bicycle lanes and/or speed trailers) **This request requires a name, address, and phone number. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 30 business days. ***** For chronic or recurring speeding/traffic violations use Traffic Violations (Chronic) - DPD or Extra Patrol - DPD.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to study traffic-speed control for a Dallas street.
actions.why: For excessive speed, pedestrian or bicycle safety, cut-through traffic, crashes, or quality-of-life concerns on a street, including possible road or speed humps, street markings, bicycle lanes, or speed trailers. The 311 request form asks whether the area is residential or commercial/industrial, lane count, location along the roadway, crosswalk impact, weekdays or weekends, time of day, and whether construction contributes. Intersections should be entered in alphabetical order. The description says a study and petition are required when requesting speed-control measures; a name, address, and phone number are required.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Traffic - Speed Control" requests does not apply to chronic or recurring speeding or traffic violations. If the concern is chronic or recurring speeding or another traffic violation, then submit a "Chronic Traffic Violations" 311 request instead. If you want additional police patrol in a neighborhood or Dallas area, then submit an "Increased Police Patrol" 311 request instead.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic - Speed Control"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic - Speed Control"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about recurring speeding or traffic violations.
actions.why: For recurring speeding or traffic violations in a specific area. The description for "Traffic - Speed Control" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs these cases to "Traffic Violations (Chronic) - DPD". The public "Chronic Traffic Violations" service has an online request form for recurring speeding, school-zone cell-phone use, street racing, and red-light or traffic-sign violations.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Chronic Traffic Violations" requests is not for parking violations. If the traffic violation is an emergency, then call 911.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Chronic Traffic Violations"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Chronic Traffic Violations"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for additional police patrol in a neighborhood or Dallas area.
actions.why: For requesting additional police patrol in a neighborhood or a specific Dallas area. The description for "Traffic - Speed Control" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs requests for extra patrol to "Extra Patrol - DPD". The public "Increased Police Patrol" service has an online request form for a neighborhood or Dallas area.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Increased Police Patrol"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Increased Police Patrol"
